errors.message:
Type mismatch
  ih
has type
  (List.map ((fun a => if key a.1 = b then a.2 else 0) ∘ fun a => (a.1, q * a.2)) rows).sum =
    q * (List.map (fun a => if key a.1 = b then a.2 else 0) rows).sum
but is expected to have type
  q * a.2 + (List.map ((fun a => if key a.1 = b then a.2 else 0) ∘ fun a => (a.1, q * a.2)) rows).sum =
    q * a.2 + q * (List.map (fun a => if key a.1 = b then a.2 else 0) rows).sum

proof_only_diff:
--- rejected-r0
+++ checked-r1
@@ -35,8 +35,11 @@
   induction rows with
   | nil => simp [fibre, scale]
   | cons a rows ih =>
-      by_cases h : key a.1 = b <;>
-        simp [fibre, scale, h, mul_add] at ih ⊢ <;> exact ih
+      change (if key a.1 = b then q * a.2 else 0) +
+          fibre key (scale q rows) b =
+        q * ((if key a.1 = b then a.2 else 0) + fibre key rows b)
+      rw [ih, mul_add]
+      by_cases h : key a.1 = b <;> simp [h]
 
 theorem fibre_bind (key : A → K) (rows : Rows A C)
     (next : A → Rows A C) (b : K) :
@@ -86,12 +89,12 @@
 The theorem does not assume that a successful native map operation proves it. -/
 theorem compressed_step [Fintype K] (key : A → K)
     (rows compressed : Rows A C) (next : A → Rows A C)
-    (table : K → K → C) (prefix : K → C)
+    (table : K → K → C) (prefixWeights : K → C)
     (hqueried : ∀ a ∈ rows, ∀ b, fibre key (next a.1) b = table (key a.1) b)
-    (hprefix : ∀ k, fibre key rows k = prefix k)
+    (hprefix : ∀ k, fibre key rows k = prefixWeights k)
     (hcompressed : ∀ b, fibre key compressed b = fibre key (bindRows rows next) b)
     (b : K) :
-    fibre key compressed b = ∑ k : K, prefix k * table k b := by
+    fibre key compressed b = ∑ k : K, prefixWeights k * table k b := by
   rw [hcompressed, queried_bind_matrix key rows next table hqueried]
   simp_rw [hprefix]
